# Life OS Dashboard Instructions

Stand: 2026-06-18
Status: Active

Use for any Dashboard V5 work.

- V5 remains the visual truth: `Life OS – Linear Calm Dark Command Center`.
- Dashboard layout is locked after the accepted V5 state.
- Do not change layout values without explicit `layout` scope.
- Locked values include width, height, min-height, max-width, grid-cols, grid-rows, gap, padding, margin, top, left, right, bottom.
- P0 must dominate: Today Agenda and Daily Control.
- Do not introduce a new design direction.
- Do not reactivate old dashboard variants.
- Do not add neon, glow-heavy, generic AI-slop, chart-flood or glass-overload styling.
- For UI changes, read `docs/design/dashboard-layout-lock.md` and `docs/engineering/dashboard-code-structure.md`.
- For motion/effects, also read `docs/design/effects-and-motion.md`.
- Keep changes small, file-specific and reviewable.
